watches.name: 39mm Combat B74 GMT
watches.description: LÜM-TEC Combat B74 GMT The proven Combat B series has been continually evolved and improved since our original Combat B1 debuted in 2007. Built for demanding environments, the series has been used in military applications, from scorching deserts to freezing mountaintops. The B74 brings that established construction into a more compact 39mm case, with the added functionality of a true GMT movement. The Miyota 9075 automatic movement features an independently adjustable local hour hand, allowing the wearer to change time zones without disturbing the minute hand or GMT reference. Each movement is regulated in 6 positions after assembly and protected by our anti-shock mounting system. The forged 316L stainless steel case measures just 46mm lug-to-lug, with downward-curving lugs designed to fit comfortably on smaller wrists. A triple-layer dial, diamond-cut hands and our MDV luminous technology provide excellent legibility. Each B74 is assembled and tested by hand in Ohio and produced as a limited, individually numbered series of 500 pieces. Specs: 39mm case width, forged and heat treated 316L surgical grade stainless steel 13.8mm case thickness 46mm lug-to-lug 20mm lug width Fine bead blasted finish Anti-fingerprint coating 200 meters water resistance 28,800 BPH Miyota 9075 Japan ultra-slim automatic movement with true GMT, jumping individual hour setting, hacking and hand-winding features Timing adjusted in 6 positions after assembling for maximum accuracy Anti-shock movement mounting system Curved sapphire with military grade inner AR coating Exhibition caseback with sapphire window Threaded crown with double diamond seals and high-tech Viton® gaskets 2 nylon military style straps with hardened Titanium carbide hardware. Black and desert tan. 3 layer dial with bead blasted matte black and charcoal gray finish Diamond-cut premium hand set with back-filled X1 C3 luminous application MDV® Luminous Technology with Swiss X1 grade C3 Super-Luminova Lifetime free timing adjustment, seal cleaning and pressure testing Limited and numbered series of 500 worldwide 2-year limited warranty Designed, assembled by hand and fully tested in Ohio The Combat B cases are made from 316L surgical grade stainless steel. We use forged construction to re-align the metal grain structure to increase fatigue strength by 37% over a typical cast steel case. This also eliminates voids and porosity in the metal, allowing for the finest possible finishing level. A heat treatment is done to improve the stability of the metal during the forging process and to harden the metal surface after finishing. Bead blast finishing creates a micro work hardened surface to improve scratch and ding resistance by 8-10% over brushed or polished finishes. It leaves a smooth satin finish. We add a physical vapor deposited anti-fingerprint coating to fill microscopic pores from the bead blasting and leave an even smoother finish that prevents oily smudges and fingerprints on the case. The thick, slightly domed, Hytrel mounted sapphire creates a wider angle reflection which makes the dial easier to see without harsh reflection. Clarity is further enhanced by the military grade anti-reflective DLC coating applied to the inside of the sapphire. Silicone lubricated, double Viton gasket seals are in the crown and the tightly sealed, threaded caseback to resist saltwater, chemicals and extreme hot and cold environments. Our sealing system has been improved by over 200% since our original Combat B1 model and tested to exceed our 200 meter depth rating by 30%, ensuring complete sealing in not only water depths but in all environments. The case is designed with lugs that curve downward, wrapping around your wrist. The 46mm lug-to-lug length has a steep downward curve, allowing the watch to fit even a small wrist without feeling excessively large. With a smaller 39mm size, light weight, a perfectly symmetrical dial design, and a durable, solar powered movement, the solar marine is packed with features and ready for adventure. watches.name: M94 Bronze Date
watches.description: LÜM-TEC M94 Bronze Date GMT The M94 Bronze GMT is built around a solid CuSn8 bronze case, a compact 44mm profile and the Miyota 9075 true GMT movement. The case is finely brushed and will develop a natural patina over time, giving each watch a finish that becomes more individual with wear. The date display is positioned at 4:30 to preserve the symmetry and legibility of the dial. The 9075 movement provides an independently adjustable local hour hand, making the M94 practical for travel without sacrificing the simplicity of a traditional mechanical watch. The movement is regulated in six positions in-house, protected by our anti-shock mounting system and visible through the sapphire caseback. A double-curved sapphire, 200 meters of water resistance, MDV luminous technology and a genuine Horween leather strap complete the package. Each M94 is assembled and tested by hand in Ohio and produced as a limited, individually numbered series of 100 pieces. Specs: 44mm case width, solid CuSn8 bronze case and crown 13.8mm case thickness including domed sapphire 51mm lug-to-lug 24mm lug width Watch head weight: 112 grams Fine brushed finishing 200 meters water resistance Japan Miyota 9075 true GMT automatic movement Individual jump hour hand setting Precision tuned to +/- 0-5 seconds/day tolerance in six positions Self-winding mechanism with ball bearing 28,800 vibrations per hour, 4 Hz, 24 jewels Power reserve: 42 hours Anti-shock movement mounting system Double curved low dome sapphire with military grade AR coating Double diamond sealed sapphire threaded caseback Threaded crown with double Viton® seals Matte black dial with date @ 4:30 High tech Viton® case gaskets Top grade genuine Horween leather strap with bronze tone PVD buckle MDV luminous technology on dial and hands Lifetime free timing adjustments, seal cleaning and pressure testing Limited and numbered series of 100 worldwide 2 year limited warranty Designed, assembled by hand and fully tested in Ohio

watches.name: Combat B60 24HR Automatic
watches.description: The proven, ultra-tough Combat B series has been continually evolved and improved since our original Combat B1 debuted in 2007. These watches have been battle-tested in real military applications and in the harshest environments, from scorching deserts to freezing mountaintops. The Combat B series emerges unscathed and ready for more. This longtime favorite is always ready to go. It looks great, is extremely comfortable on the wrist, supremely legible, undeniably accurate, and has proven anti-shock capability in the field. It is trusted by pilots, ground soldiers, snipers, mountain climbers, and people who appreciate a watch engineered from the ground up in the USA to perform at the highest level. Designed, assembled by hand, and fully tested in Ohio. Forged and heat-treated, surgical-grade 316L stainless steel 43mm case Titanium Carbide gunmetal PVD hard coating Anti-fingerprint coating 22mm lug width 200 meters water resistance 28,800 BPH Miyota 9075 ultra-slim automatic movement, configured for a 24-hour display, with hacking and hand-winding Timing adjusted in six positions after assembly for maximum accuracy Anti-shock movement mounting system Curved sapphire with military-grade inner AR coating Threaded solid caseback Threaded crown with double diamond seals High-tech Viton® gaskets Two military-style straps included: one charcoal gray nylon strap and one tan leather strap with gunmetal PVD hardware MDV® luminous technology with custom-developed grade X1 Swiss 208LE Super-LumiNova in a vintage patina radium color and X1 C3 on the dial and hands. Green-tone glow color. All-metal dial with a bead-blasted matte tobacco finish Diamond-cut premium hand set with back-filled X1 C3 luminous application Lifetime free timing adjustment, seal cleaning, and pressure testing Limited and numbered series of 300 worldwide Two-year limited warranty The Combat B cases are made from surgical-grade 316L stainless steel. We use forged construction to realign the metal grain structure and increase fatigue strength by 37% over a typical cast steel case. This also eliminates voids and porosity in the metal, allowing for the finest possible finishing. A heat treatment is used to improve the stability of the metal during the forging process and harden the metal surface after finishing. The bead-blasted finish creates a micro-work-hardened surface that improves scratch and ding resistance by 8 to 10% over brushed or polished finishes. It leaves a flawless, smooth satin finish. We add a physical vapor-deposited anti-fingerprint coating to fill microscopic pores left by the bead blasting. This creates an even smoother surface that resists oily smudges and fingerprints. The thick, slightly domed, Hytrel-mounted sapphire creates a wider-angle reflection that makes the dial easier to see without harsh glare. Clarity is further enhanced by the military-grade anti-reflective coating applied to the inside of the sapphire. Silicone-lubricated double Viton gasket seals are used in the crown and tightly sealed threaded caseback to resist saltwater, chemicals, and extremely hot and cold environments. Our sealing system has improved by more than 200% since the original Combat B1. It is tested to exceed our 200-meter depth rating by 30%, ensuring dependable sealing in water and other harsh environments. The case has lugs that curve downward and wrap around the wrist. The 51.5mm lug-to-lug length may sound long, but much of that length comes from the steep downward curve. The watch wraps around even a small wrist without feeling oversized, wearing more like a watch with an effective lug-to-lug length of 46 to 47mm. This is one reason the Combat B case is so well-loved by thousands of owners around the world. It is extremely comfortable and barely noticeable on the wrist. watches.description: The razor thin Eclipse series is designed to absolutely melt over your wrist. Over two years of engineering and development went into this absolute masterpiece of a wristwatch. With its 3mm leading edge case blending into its 3mm thick flat link and chamfered bracelet, the feeling is that this watch actually becomes part of your wrist. The bracelet is tapered from 26mm all the way down to 18mm at the clasp adding to its comfort. Each bracelet link has its own pivot at just 2mm apart to allow the bracelet to lay perfectly. With a set of solid, floating 3D luminous markers around the edge of the dial, legibility and symmetry is unmatched. While this is a perfect watch for any formal occasion, its also perfect as a daily watch ready to handle anything with its 100 meter water resistance and anti-shock movement mounting. So how did we make a watch that looks and feels so delicate and beautifully thin, yet retains our legendary LUM-TEC durability? Years of engineering and truly advanced construction. Extreme comfort, intense luminosity, quality and finishing levels punching far above its weight, this watch is sure to impress even the most serious watch fans.
